Sensitivity of the ranked list to the physical minimum-area rule. The aggregation floor is 0.36 ha; the ranking floor is 1.0 ha, because a four-pixel unit is large enough to average but too small to present as a restoration-priority area. `shared_with_primary_threshold` counts how many of the top 10 units are the same as at the 1.0 ha floor.

- `ranking` — mean RIS_balanced
